facts.fact: The Official Gazette text of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, signed 12 June 2023, lists in its contents a Part VIII on cross-border transfers of personal data (sections 41 to 43: basis for transfer, adequacy of protection, other bases for transfer outside Nigeria); the captured text stops at the contents and gives no provision wording.

note: Document is an excerpt (front matter and contents only); the provisions themselves are not stated.
